caseNameFull: Harry Fleisher v. United States Sam Fleisher v. Same and Stein v. Same
attorneys: Messrs. Isidore G. Stone, Alfred A. May, and Arthur H. Ratner for petitioners. Solicitor General Reed, Assistant Attorney General McMahon, Mahlon D. Kiefer, and W. Marvin Smith for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted, limited to the question whether the first count of the indictment states an offense under federal law.

Reported below: 91 F. (2d) 404.
